turns.question: What was our CPA on search in September 2026?
turns.answer: CPA is not a defined term in our metrics, so here are both closest figures for search in September 2026 (1 to 30 September): cost per booking (cost per conversion) was EUR 124.84, and cost per lead was EUR 42.07.
